resources.string: Open the app to see status and score
Android may pause or kill the booster in the background. Turn off battery optimization for uninterrupted use.
Your phone closes apps when you tap \"Clear all\" in Recents. Lock Speed Booster so it keeps boosting.
Speed Booster was closed in the background, probably when Recents was cleared. Lock it in Recents so this doesn\'t happen again.
Once locked, \"Clear all\" skips Speed Booster and the booster keeps running.
1. Open Recents (swipe up and hold, or tap the square button).\n2. Long-press the Speed Booster card (or swipe it down).\n3. Tap the lock icon. A small lock appears on the card.
1. Open Recents.\n2. Tap the Speed Booster icon at the top of its card.\n3. Tap \"Lock this app\" (or \"Keep open\").
1. Open Recents.\n2. Tap the ⋮ menu on the Speed Booster card (or swipe the card down).\n3. Tap \"Lock\". A lock icon appears on the card.
1. Open Recents.\n2. Swipe the Speed Booster card down (or long-press it).\n3. Tap the lock icon.
1. Open Recents.\n2. Swipe the Speed Booster card down.\n3. A lock icon appears on the card.
1. Open Recents.\n2. Swipe the Speed Booster card down (or long-press it).\n3. Tap the lock icon.
1. Open Recents.\n2. Long-press the Speed Booster card, swipe it down, or tap the app icon above it.\n3. Choose \"Lock\" or \"Keep open\" if your phone offers it.
Locked. \"Clear all\" won\'t close the booster.
Not locked. Tap to see how.
Not needed on this phone. Tap for steps anyway.
On Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO also enable Autostart and set Battery saver to \"No restrictions\" in App info.
On Samsung also set Battery to \"Unrestricted\" and keep the app out of \"Sleeping apps\".
On Huawei / Honor also set App launch to \"Manage manually\" with all switches on.
On Oppo / Realme / OnePlus also allow Auto-launch and background activity.
On Vivo / iQOO also allow High background power consumption.
Pick how hard the app keeps your connection awake.
Lowest lag for games and calls. Uses more battery.
Strongest keep-alive for heavy browsing and downloads.
Recommended. Keeps Hutch fast with normal battery use.
Set your own options under Advanced.
For experienced users. Changing anything here switches Boost mode to Custom.
On. Tap to turn off for uninterrupted use.
Off. The booster can run uninterrupted.
HTTP: minimum 1 s. Default is 20 s.
ICMP: minimum 0.1 s. Use a host that answers pings: Hutch 1 and 2 are Hutch\'s own servers; \"Hutch DNS (auto)\" pings the DNS servers of your SIM connection.
Tip: add the \"Booster\" tile to Quick Settings. Turning it off there stops the booster and closes the app completely.
